summary: Columbia County, WA: L-4 tower built 1937 on the Umatilla NF; now gone and listed as removed. The mapped site is disputed and no remains have been found.

facts.status_note: Removed; no remnants of the lookout have been found

notes_for_editor: Built 1937 and the lookout being gone are supported. No removal date, staffing, fire history or public access was found in any source read. The location is disputed: the record's coordinates are the mapped Jumpoff Joe point, which Willhite says still needs a visit; he proposes Abels Benchmark based on a 1963 survey note of a 90-foot tower, unconfirmed. Do not confuse with Jumpoff Lookout in Yakima County (Wenatchee NF), the Jump Off Joe butte in Benton County, or the Newport, Oregon sea stack; none describes this 1937 Columbia County tower. The Forest Lookouts index also shows a separate 'Jumpoff' entry under another county, which was not checked.
